newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder raises Chevron year EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder raises Chevron year EPS.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim analyst Michael Mayer has raised his year earnings per share forecast for Chevron Corp to $4.05 from $4.00 after the company reported adjusted first quarter EPS of $1.23 compared with $0.94 a year ago, five to 10 cents above analysts' expectations.
-- The forecast is based on $21 per barrel spot WTI and $2.10 per thousand cubic feet for natural gas.
-- "We continue to think that market expectations for sustainable oil prices wil increase and that this will lead to improved sentiment and better relative valuations for the major oils," Mayer said.
Chevron was trading down 1/8 at 66-1/2 after reporting earnings. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
